g.text: Title: Controller board: MCU (ESP32-C3-DevKit-RUST-2), 3.3 V and safety gate

g.desc: Title: Controller board: MCU (ESP32-C3-DevKit-RUST-2), 3.3 V and safety gate

g.text: ESP32-C3-DevKit-RUST-2 (D-55), RJ45 LINK 4 opto current loops (D-56, D-57)

g.desc: ESP32-C3-DevKit-RUST-2 (D-55), RJ45 LINK 4 opto current loops (D-56, D-57)

g.text: J2 2x12 to RF board J14 (D-51, D-52). PTT to K0 in hardware (no MCU)

g.desc: J2 2x12 to RF board J14 (D-51, D-52). PTT to K0 in hardware (no MCU)

g.text: Stackup and size: to decide with the layout

g.desc: Stackup and size: to decide with the layout

g.text: MCU: ESP32-C3-DevKit-RUST-2 Rev 2.0 on two sockets (D-55). 3V3 pin from U11 (LDO); ENABLE low keeps the board buck off;

g.desc: MCU: ESP32-C3-DevKit-RUST-2 Rev 2.0 on two sockets (D-55). 3V3 pin from U11 (LDO); ENABLE low keeps the board buck off;

g.text: 5V/VBUS not connected, so the PC can stay on USB (board diode D6). Wi-Fi and BLE off in firmware.

g.desc: 5V/VBUS not connected, so the PC can stay on USB (board diode D6). Wi-Fi and BLE off in firmware.

g.text: I2C: board bus SDA GPIO7, SCL GPIO8 (10k on the board; 2.2k on the RF board), SHTC3 0x70 and ICM-42670-P 0x68 on the board.

g.desc: I2C: board bus SDA GPIO7, SCL GPIO8 (10k on the board; 2.2k on the RF board), SHTC3 0x70 and ICM-42670-P 0x68 on the board.

g.text: GPIO0 EXP_INT, GPIO1 WDI (kick at least every 0.9 s), GPIO3 LATCH_CLR (rising edge), GPIO4 MCU_EN_N (low = relays allowed),

g.desc: GPIO0 EXP_INT, GPIO1 WDI (kick at least every 0.9 s), GPIO3 LATCH_CLR (rising edge), GPIO4 MCU_EN_N (low = relays allowed),

g.text: GPIO5 KILL (read), GPIO20/21 UART 9600 baud. GPIO2, 8, 9 are strapping pins: GPIO2 and GPIO9 not used; GPIO8 is SCL. GPIO6 spare.

g.desc: GPIO5 KILL (read), GPIO20/21 UART 9600 baud. GPIO2, 8, 9 are strapping pins: GPIO2 and GPIO9 not used; GPIO8 is SCL. GPIO6 spare.

g.text: Safety gate (D-59): RLY_EN = NOR(KILL, MCU_EN_N, FAULT). FAULT is set by RESET_N: power-up, 3V3 below 2.83 to 3.00 V, or no WDI edge for 0.9 to 2.5 s.

g.desc: Safety gate (D-59): RLY_EN = NOR(KILL, MCU_EN_N, FAULT). FAULT is set by RESET_N: power-up, 3V3 below 2.83 to 3.00 V, or no WDI edge for 0.9 to 2.5 s.

g.text: After a reset the relays stay off until the MCU gives a LATCH_CLR edge. KILL is not latched. RLY_EN has a 100k pull-down on the RF board.

g.desc: After a reset the relays stay off until the MCU gives a LATCH_CLR edge. KILL is not latched. RLY_EN has a 100k pull-down on the RF board.

g.text: U12 RESET_N does not reset the MCU (DevKit pin 1 RST open); the ESP32-C3 has its own watchdogs. MR open: internal 90k pull-up.

g.desc: U12 RESET_N does not reset the MCU (DevKit pin 1 RST open); the ESP32-C3 has its own watchdogs. MR open: internal 90k pull-up.
